title: Length field narrowed with `as u8` — silently truncates

pr_metadata.title: frame: compact header
pr_metadata.body: Payloads are small; one byte is enough.

labels.defect: `len as u8` truncates silently for payloads over 255 bytes; the checked conversion was removed
labels.evidence: A 300-byte payload writes header 44 — the peer reads a short frame and the rest is parsed as the next message (desync). try_from returned an error before.
